outcome.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. The worktree currently starts at epic/grade-pray a8856584aaaa44017ac1de2cdc710876b1fbb706; PR #791 has historical merge base b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0 and head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef. It first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install --frozen-lockfile if needed without updating the committed lockfile and verifies the worktree remains clean, then runs bun run --filter observation test once and one targeted T1 run covering oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: PR #791 is auditable at head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef and both requested behaviors are present. No operator-only decision or code conflict blocks the audit. Before planning, the specification should correct its stale worktree-base statement and align T1 evidence scope with the files and tests that actually prove ordered launch delivery.

findings.description: The starting-state statement is stale. The current worktree and origin/epic/grade-pray resolve to a8856584aaaa44017ac1de2cdc710876b1fbb706, PR #791 head resolves to db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, and their merge base is b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0. Gated review confirms PR #791 is merged with base branch epic/grade-pray and the specified head. The explicit detached checkout still selects the correct audit subject, so this is not blocking.

T1 is implemented at the requested commit: oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41 treats an omitted grading_enabled as false, rejects non-booleans, permits omitted sessions, and returns the normalized config; oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48 attaches the exact committed config to the launched run_input and preserves no-config as null.

The two T1 paths do not by themselves establish the specification phrase ordered launch delivery. The delivery envelope reads the committed config and couples it to the event cursor in oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20, while single-row cursor-driven publication is in oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:32-46 and transaction ordering is defined in oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts:481-499. These paths should be included in T1 audit scope.

The mandated command bun run --filter observation test invokes only bun test ./tests for the observation workspace, as shown by package.json:7-11 and observation/package.json:6-11. It does not run the direct T1 coverage in oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83, oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:55-65, or the replay test in oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209. Without an added T1 test command, the assessor must explicitly qualify T1 as not covered by builder test_evidence.

T2 exact-claim settlement is implemented at the requested commit. observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:196-227 defines the current claim as claimed status plus exact owner, attempt, and unexpired database-time lease, locks before checking, and fences the authoritative write again. observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95 passes that same claim through request marking and completion/failure settlement.

T2 completion is atomic: observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-292 performs the fenced execution update, provider-attempt update, and grade_observation insert inside one withTenant transaction. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244 verifies a refused observation insert leaves both completion and answer absent, and observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357 verifies expired and lock-wait-expired claims cannot settle. These are integration tests and are skipped without OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL unless CI mode forces execution, per observation/tests/grading-fixture.ts:21-22; the builder must report the actual outcome rather than infer a pass.
